# Host operations

The game side answers 744 named operations in 73 domains. Every Lua function is a thin wrapper over one of them: `game.pawns.skills(p)` sends `pawn.skills` with `{ h = <pawn> }`. You rarely need the op name, but it is what `t.mock("pawn.skills", ...)` in a [test](../guide/testing.md) replaces, what the audit log and the [profiler](../guide/performance.md) print, and what `rim.invoke` takes. A mock for a name that is not in this list is refused with `RK1001`.

| Tier | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| gameplay | Reads and changes the colony. Allowed for every mod |
| util | Helpers such as JSON, files in the mod folder, key bindings |
| advanced | Reflection, hooks, def changes. Gated by capabilities and settings |
| legacy | The older operations from before the kit tables. They still work and have the same names |

Subject-first calls name the subject `h`. A DLC operation fails with `RK3003` when that expansion is not active.
